cohort: The study participants included 30 patients diagnosed with Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy (HDP) and 30 healthy controls.
finding: The study found significant disruptions in lipid metabolism, particularly fatty acyls (FAs), in patients with HDP, and identified a strong correlation between MCAM expression and FA metabolism and HDP-related symptoms, potentially involving the MAPK pathway.
cross-section timing: Peripheral blood samples were taken from patients with HDP and healthy controls, implying a cross-sectional assessment during pregnancy when HDP was diagnosed.
